sentences.text: Shri Sachin Arya, learned counsel for the appellant.
Shri Dinesh Singh Chouhan, learned counsel for the State.

Heard on I.A. No.950 of 2026, an application filed under Section 5 of the Limitation Act for condonation of delay in filing the application for bringing the legal heirs of the deceased sole appellant on record who died on 07.11.2021.
Considering that the fact present proceedings relate to compensation arising out of acquisition of land of the landowners and the explanation tendered in the application, the same is allowed.
Accordingly, the delay in filing the application for bringing the legal heirs of the deceased sole appellant on record as well as the application for setting aside is hereby condoned.
Also heard on I.A. No.949 of 2026, an application for setting aside the abatement of the appeal on account of the death of the sole appellant.
On due consideration, the application is allowed.
As a consequence, I.A. No.948 of 2024, an application filed under Order XXII Rule 3 read with Section 151 of the CPC is also allowed.
The legal heirs of the deceased sole appellant are permitted to be brought on record.
Steps for correction of the cause-title be taken within a period of three 2 FA-2330-2018 working days.
List the matter along with FA No.676/2018.

(PAVAN KUMAR DWIVEDI) JUDGE Anushree Ramchandra vs M.P. Sadak Vikas Nigam Ltd. on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116845641/
